channel.title: Gather Data :: K-State CS Textbook Extras
channel.description: Video Walkthrough Resources Slides Kansas Mesonet NOAA Weather Data Teacher Notes You can expand upon this section by linking it to discussions around local weather patterns or a larger module on the climate and weather in general. Students could be encouraged to collect their own weather data for a time period and use that data in this activity (with a bit of formatting help). While this activity is rooted in weather data, the same basic process can be used to analyze data of all types.
